integrity: Proof-based same-model review with a supplementary independent-code-path finite verifier. No third-party mathematical validation or exhaustive historical-priority certification.
limitations: The first threshold is fixed at 1/2; global two-stage adaptive optimality is not claimed. The strict advantage over unrestricted nonadaptive threshold pairs is a high-noise asymptotic. Uniform prior and two independent equal-known-noise binary queries only.
title: Adaptive squared-loss threshold localization: a unique nonmedian follow-up and a fourth-order feedback gain
